Liam —

Thanks, got the CAIQ. We do map answers to CCM control IDs and will return a completed CAIQ mapping plus evidence pointers. Quick summary of our approach: 

- We provide a per-question answer (Yes/Partial/No) and cite the CCM control(s) we consider relevant (e.g., IDM-01/IDM-02 for identity controls, DSI-01 for data inventory).
- For evidentiary artifacts, we attach or link to a small set of canonical documents (network diagram, retention policy, sample audit event export) and point to the Console pages where customers can see audit logs and model access traces.
- For prioritized requests (30 controls), our SLA for an initial mapping + evidence pointers is 3 business days. Full artifacts for larger sets depend on approvals but typically delivered within 7–10 business days.

I've attached our preliminary CAIQ mapping (spreadsheet) that maps CAIQ questions to Redwood CCM control IDs and notes where evidence lives. Please confirm which 30 controls you want prioritized; otherwise we'll prioritize identity, data protection, and encryption controls by default.
